_doc: Paralia brand component rules. Edit here, run compile.js to regenerate compiled/paralia-components.css.

button._doc: Paralia buttons are pill-shaped, matching the chip toggle and brand aesthetic. Padding is em-based so height scales proportionally if --btn-font-size is overridden to a different type tier.

chip._doc: Chip toggles are pill-shaped in Paralia. Smaller than buttons by default (font-size-sm).

slider._doc: Slider track is thin (3px), thumb uses --color-signal (orange).

input._doc: Inputs are pill-shaped in Paralia. Padding is em-based, matching button proportions.

badge._doc: Badges are small and sharp-cornered for data density. Px-based (not a scalable pill control).

card._doc: Cards and panel islands use large rounding in Paralia.

loader._doc: Thin animated progress bar used on loading/transition screens.

shelf._doc: App-launcher tray for the /apps page. Bg/border/text/label-color are literal dark-theme hex values (same constants as --color-panel/--color-rule/--color-text/--color-muted's dark-root values in paralia.json), not var(--color-*) references — those primitives flip under body.light and would wash the shelf out on light-themed pages.

header._doc: Left-rail brand/title block, matching paradigm's original inline header. title-font-size uses var(--font-size-display-2), which happens to equal 17px in Paralia's primitive tokens.

theme-toggle._doc: Floating light/dark toggle pill, matching paradigm's original inline toggle. radius is a literal 999px (not var(--radius-pill), which is only 3px in Paralia's primitives and wouldn't read as a pill here).

variant-card._doc: Case/variant gallery card. Sharp-ish corners matching the badge/table density philosophy, not pill-shaped like buttons/chips/inputs.
